raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`traverse_tree` which is used by DFlash and other specdec paths to build the grammar bitmask over the draft tree  calls `grammar.accept_token()` on every draft token that passed its parent's mask row. If the matcher rejects one anyway, the `ValueError` is not caught and kills the scheduler rather than just aborting a single request.

I'm still looking for reproducible root cause, this PR is for containment to avoid bad state.

## Modifications

- `traverse_tree`: track how many draft tokens are accepted along the DFS path. On `ValueError`, roll those back so the grammar is at its pre-traversal state, then re-raise.
- `generate_token_bitmask`: catch the `ValueError` per request, log it, set that request's mask rows to all-allowed, and set `req.to_finish = FINISH_ABORT()`, as `_accept_grammar_tokens` does.

## Tests

Unit tests in `test_spec_utils_traverse_tree.py`:
- `traverse_tree` leaves the grammar rolled back to its starting state when a deep draft token is rejected.
- `generate_token_bitmask` aborts only the rejecting request; the other request in the batch is untouched and its grammar is restored.

End-to-end, since I can't trigger the real desync on demand: I injected the failure by making `XGrammarGrammar.accept_token` raise `ValueError` when called from `dfs` for requests whose schema contains a marker key. Setup was Qwen3-0.6B, 1x L40S, `--speculative-algorithm NGRAM --grammar-backend xgrammar`, one poisoned `json_schema` request sent concurrently with six normal ones, on the nightly-dev-20261014 image with `python/` overlaid from each tree:

| | poisoned req | other 6 reqs | server |
|---|---|---|---|
| main (44b44774c3) | connection dropped | all dropped | scheduler exception, SIGQUIT, `/health_generate` unreachable |
| this PR | `finish_reason: abort` | all `stop`, valid JSON | alive, `/health_generate` 200, follow-up request OK |

## Accuracy / speed

No change to the non-error path; the added bookkeeping is one integer increment per traversed node.

## Checklist

- [x] Format with pre-commit (isort, ruff, codespell run on the changed files)
- [x] Unit tests added

@@ -107,5 +113,68 @@ def test_linear_chain_stops_at_grammar_reject(self):
         self.assertEqual(fill_calls, [0, 1])
 
 
+class _StatefulGrammar:
+    """Tracks accepted tokens; rejects any token in ``reject``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, reject=()):
+        self.reject = set(reject)
+        self.accepted = []
+
+    def accept_token(self, token):
+        if token in self.reject:
+            raise ValueError(f"Tokens not accepted: {token}")
+        self.accepted.append(token)
+
+    def rollback(self, k):
+        del self.accepted[len(self.accepted) - k :]
+
+    def is_terminated(self):
+        return False
+
+    def fill_vocab_mask(self, bitmask, idx):
+        pass
+
+    def allocate_vocab_mask(self, vocab_size, batch_size, device):
+        return torch.full((batch_size, (vocab_size + 31) // 32), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+
+
+class TestTraverseTreeGrammarReject(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The grammar mask allowed a draft token that accept_token then rejects."""
+
+    def test_traverse_tree_restores_grammar_before_raising(self):
+        rnt, rns, draft_tokens = (
+            t[0]
+            for t in GrammarTree.from_linear_chain(
+                torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4]])
+            ).resolve()
+        )
+        bitmask = torch.full((4, 1), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+        grammar = _StatefulGrammar(reject={4})
+
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            traverse_tree(rnt, rns, draft_tokens, grammar, bitmask)
+
+        # 2 and 3 were accepted before 4 was rejected; both must be rolled back.
+        self.assertEqual(grammar.accepted, [])
+
+    def test_generate_token_bitmask_aborts_only_the_rejected_request(self):
+        chain = torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 2, 3, 4]])
+        rnt, rns, draft_tokens = GrammarTree.from_linear_chain(chain).resolve()
+        bad = SimpleNamespace(
+            rid="bad", grammar=_StatefulGrammar(reject={3}), to_finish=None
+        )
+        good = SimpleNamespace(rid="good", grammar=_StatefulGrammar(), to_finish=None)
+
+        bitmask, _ = generate_token_bitmask(
+            [bad, good], rnt, rns, draft_tokens, vocab_size=32
+        )
+
+        self.assertIsInstance(bad.to_finish, FINISH_ABORT)
+        self.assertEqual(bad.grammar.accepted, [])
+        self.assertTrue((bitmask[:4] == -1).all())
+        self.assertIsNone(good.to_finish)
+        self.assertEqual(good.grammar.accepted, [])  # rolled back after traversal
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
